caveats: Use simulated slew 230 V/us; measured hardware slew about 130 V/us (page 20) is separately attributed to generator rise time. Calculated bound 213 V/us (page 6) is yet another quantity.
Table 2 stages vary with output amplitude. In particular rm and total gain fall materially between 10 and 60 Vpp; one universal paper target loses this context.

Paper table caption mentions summing Q10/Q12 collector currents, Table 1 labels Q11+Q13, and Eq.16 writes Q11 alone. Retained expression sums Q11 and Q13 and matches Table 1 magnitudes; record inconsistency rather than changing measurement.

Original simulations are LTspice; retained pack uses Spectre with fixed discrete BJT models, nominal +/-42 V, corner rails +/-37.8 or +/-46.2 V and temperatures -40/27/85 C. No original table covers this retained corner grid.
Retained sine amplitude vin_pk=0.174216 V at 50 Hz targets about 10 Vpp; use saved actual Vout_pp to confirm amplitude match.
Retained slew test explicitly disables input filter (input_filter_scale=0), consistent with original simulated slew method.
